mapper.select: select r.run_id, coalesce(cp.last_stream_id, '0-0') as last_stream_id, coalesce(r.message_sender_user_id, r.triggered_by_user_id) as user_id, coalesce(u.username, '') as username, coalesce(u.organization, '') as organization, coalesce(u.rd_department, '') as rd_department, coalesce(u.department, '') as department, coalesce(r.session_id, '') as session_id, coalesce(r.workspace_id, '') as workspace_id, coalesce(r.agent_id, 'default') as agent_id, coalesce(r.model_id, '') as model_id from runs r left join users u on u.user_id = coalesce(r.message_sender_user_id, r.triggered_by_user_id) left join analytics_redis_outbox_checkpoints cp on cp.run_id = r.run_id where r.storage_mode = 'REDIS_SUMMARY' and (r.status in ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'CANCELLING') or r.updated_at >= #{recentTerminalThreshold}) order by r.updated_at desc limit #{limit}

select concat('backfill-v1:user-dimension:', u.user_id) as event_id, greatest(1, (extract(epoch from u.updated_at) * 1000)::bigint) as event_version, 'USER_DIMENSION' as source_type, u.user_id as aggregate_id, current_timestamp as occurred_at, jsonb_build_object( 'eventType', 'USER_DIMENSION', 'userId', u.user_id, 'username', u.username, 'organization', u.organization, 'rdDepartment', u.rd_department, 'department', u.department, 'status', u.status, 'attributionMode', 'CURRENT_ORG_BACKFILL' )::text as payload_json from users u order by u.user_id
select status from analytics_clickhouse_cutovers where cutover_id=#{cutoverId}
mapper.insert: insert into analytics_clickhouse_cutovers( cutover_id,status,source_row_count,target_row_count,coverage_start,coverage_end, attribution_mode,verified_at,updated_at ) values( #{cutoverId},'VERIFIED',#{sourceCount},#{targetCount},#{coverageStart},#{coverageEnd}, 'CURRENT_ORG_BACKFILL',#{verifiedAt},#{verifiedAt} ) on conflict(cutover_id) do update set status=excluded.status,source_row_count=excluded.source_row_count, target_row_count=excluded.target_row_count,coverage_start=excluded.coverage_start, coverage_end=excluded.coverage_end,attribution_mode=excluded.attribution_mode, verified_at=excluded.verified_at,updated_at=excluded.updated_at
mapper.update: drop table if exists analytics_run_duration_histogram_hourly, analytics_user_activity_daily, analytics_user_activity_hourly, analytics_rollup_job_runs, analytics_rollup_watermarks
